en: Good, good.  Now bow to each other.
The Coldtooth Mine lies in Horde territory, in the mountains north of the Frostwolf Graveyard.$B$BIt is controlled by the Kobolds.
One bright light appears accross the room, then disppears. Then you notice another beam... and then another.$B$BThey seem to be showing you a pattern.

I never stated that you were here to redeem yourself, $g priest:priestess;. You are here to redeem me and the innocents murdered while trying to escape Stratholme.$B$BMy spirit and the spirit of those lost are bound here, cursed to endlessly relive our own tragic deaths.
Have you made contact with Ivus, Arch Druid?
I suppose you're right.
King Magni Bronzebeard is a fool and a charlatan!
Atten...HUT!
Let me at 'em, $n! Just give the word and I'll mount up and attack their bridge!
You merely destroy an image, fool. I shall hunt you until the end of days.
*GRRRR* *RUFF* *RUFF*
Be sure to read over the notes in my journal, $n. You will find them to be invaluable in overcoming the tower's defenses.
What are the stones of binding?
%s lets loose a shrill cry.
Kil'jaeden is my answer.
How long can it take to pick a handful of weeds?
%s roars in excitement as he rushes Volcor. When he reaches his master, Grimclaw licks his face.
I'm back!
%s calls for his mount.
Now, then... the rod. Let's see about fixing it, shall we?
Get away from my kodo, you freak of nature!
I will call forth Eranikus when I am given the word.
Us have skinning hook.  We get it from Killian Hagey who teach us how to skin kills.  You have nice skin.  You find him on inner ring of Rogues' Quarter.
The scepter shard is no more! Your beloved Kalimdor shall soon be a desolate wasteland. I will, of course, turn the Eastern Kingdoms into an ashen, lifeless void...
Nothing. My orders were to speak with you and then speak with Thrall. All I know is that Thrall is interested in saving your princess.
One of the humans has the key to this infernal contraption. Eston I think they said his name was.

Thank you for the inquiry, $c, but as you can see, I already have all of the linen bandages that the Alliance feels is necessary in preparation for the war at Ahn'Qiraj. Don't let that stop you from helping out with the other collections going on here though.
I'm going to wear your skin as a smoking jacket! The stogies? You'll have to pry them from my cold dead... er... RAWR!!!!

There is a powerful infernal named Kroshius northeast of this camp. It is why Niby is here. Kroshius is a greater infernal - an infernal that has lasted longer than expected. You see, nub, an infernal crashes down into the earth with great intensity to serve its master but this intensity fades fast. Once the blazing flames have died down, the infernal crumbles.
Unlike most ogres, I do know what an outhouse is for - giving you a swirlie.  Now beat it.
I'd talk to you if you smelled better. How about cologne? Maybe perfume?
Where is Elder Goldwell?
Ragnaros sees all, mortal.
I have lost my Blade of Vaulted Secrets. Are you able to replace it for me?
I ordered a few shipments of new perfumes and colognes from the city. After I get them unpacked, check back and I'll have them for sale.
Hero, I have urgent business with Corporal Splithoof.

I suppose that is true. I and the rest of my elites used to belong to an order known as the Empyrean Blades. We were the personal guard of our former leader, the Shal'nan. 

In the current, uncertain times we do what we can to help lead the peacekeepers citizen militia, since we are the closest thing to professional soldiers left on Zephras.
Sunken Temple
I'm going to die, I just know it!
So you've conquered a small spot of land. A minor setback! The Scourge still reign here!
Here to learn how to wield a new weapon, or just to waste my time?
Elder Farwhisper can be found wandering the streets of Stratholme.
